## Problem

watch-dashboard, dashboard-ui, dashboard-bugfix and dashboard-features are one product area split into four efforts.

## Approach

Decide at plan-phase. Runs only after the dashboard-features session is idle. Move phases, open work-items and live records to `effort=dashboard`, renumber ordinals, close the old goals, and add a planned `dashboard-package` phase for moving the dashboard code out of `scripts/`.

## Exit criteria

Decide at plan-phase.
